name: L-Curve Regularization Parameter Selection
definition: Computes the solution norm $\|f_\alpha\|$ and residual norm $\|g - A f_\alpha\|$ across a range of regularization parameters $\alpha$ to identify the optimal trade-off point (the 'corner' of the L-curve).
summary: L-Curve Regularization Parameter Selection identifies the optimal regularization parameter by finding the corner of the log-log plot of solution and residual norms, balancing data fidelity against smoothness.
